units.function: CLI tests for Run listing/detail/cancellation, byte-paged logs, sequence-paged events, linked Issues, workspace operations/logs, watchdog decisions, manual Agent wakeup and Issue-to-Run helpers.
units.dependencyDirection: The Vitest suite composes Run, Agent and Issue Commander modules, stubs fetch/console/stdout and asserts client request paths plus watchdog and wakeup payload fragments.
units.keyDataModels: Company/Agent/Run/Issue/workspace-operation IDs, Run status/invocationSource, log offset/nextOffset/byte limit, sequenced events, workspace phase, watchdog decision/reason and wake source/trigger detail/reason/payload.
units.lifecycle: Filter Runs by company/Agent; inspect/cancel a Run; page logs/events; navigate linked Work and workspace operations; submit a watchdog continue decision; manually wake an Agent with payload; retrieve all/live/active Runs for one Issue.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 3/3 tests on 2026-08-19 and CLI no-emit TypeScript passed. It covers useful cursor/byte parameters and exact watchdog/wakeup payload fields, but omits pagination boundaries, malformed logs/events, resume/gap recovery, cancel/watchdog authorization, idempotency, concurrent state changes, evidence integrity, redaction, timeouts and stable error responses.
units.designRationale: Give operators a scriptable end-to-end diagnostic and intervention surface from Work to Run, workspace setup and event/log details, including manual watchdog recovery.
units.companyOsProblem: Agent Boss and incident operators need vendor-neutral execution visibility, bounded replay, safe cancel/pause/resume decisions and links from goals/Work to workspace activity, evidence and accountable intervention.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT sequence cursors, byte-bounded log retrieval, explicit Work-to-Run helpers and decision reasons. Replace heartbeat/vendor semantics with Connector Run projections carrying stable event ids, resumable cursors, runtime attestation, permissions/data scope and evidence integrity. Every cancel/wakeup/watchdog intervention must bind a human principal, expected Run revision, action digest, risk/approval and durable result.
units.responsibilityConflict: The command surface attributes manual wakeup only through free-text reason/source and watchdog decision, without proving accountable human identity/authority or binding the exact Work/config/data/evidence state. Operational logs/events are not automatically responsibility evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-19 focused Vitest: 1 file and 3 tests passed
securityFindings: Bearer authentication is fixed-success; tenant/resource authorization for Run, Issue, workspace and Agent actions is not tested.
Cancel, watchdog decision and manual wakeup have no tested expected revision, idempotency key, approval token, capability check or immutable audit receipt.
Wakeup accepts arbitrary JSON payload text; schema validation, size limits, secret/private-session rejection and data classification are untested.
Event sequence pagination is routed but gap detection, duplicate handling, cursor expiry and reconnect recovery are not verified.
Log byte pagination is routed but Unicode byte accuracy, truncation boundaries, retention, integrity digest, redaction and access classification are not covered.
Workspace logs and Run-linked Issue listings may expose host/data topology; field-level authorization and least-data projections are untested.
Watchdog `continue` with free-text reason is not bound to the exact suspended action or evidence digest, allowing approval/substitution ambiguity unless enforced by the server.
